business_problem: NIO wanted to bring large-model capabilities into its smart cockpit so drivers could get richer open-domain Q&A, travel guidance and emotional interaction without sacrificing the in-car user experience.
solution_summary: NIO and Baidu AI Cloud used ERNIE and Baidu's model infrastructure to turn NOMI into a cloud-connected cockpit AI partner across the NT2.0 and 2.2 vehicle platforms. The architecture adds a new NOMI GPT interface layer that can render generated content more naturally, while the large-model service underneath supports encyclopedia Q&A, travel guidance, creative learning, unlimited chatting, expressive mood interactions and vehicle-use questions. One especially cockpit-specific feature is the 'magic atmosphere' workflow, which uses large-model reasoning to map user intents into millions of ambient-light combinations so the car can translate language into a physical cabin effect. The system also uses Baidu's heterogeneous-compute and large-model stack to keep the assistant responsive at vehicle scale. In practice, driver or passenger prompts enter NOMI, pass through cloud-side inference and retrieval logic, and return as multimodal responses inside the cabin interface.

solution_components.name: BaiGe Heterogeneous Compute Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the compute backbone for large-model services behind the cockpit assistant.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Hosts and manages the model capabilities integrated into NIO's cockpit assistant.

solution_components.name: NOMI GPT
solution_components.role: Acts as the user-facing intelligent cockpit partner with a new generative interface.

solution_components.name: ERNIE Large Model
solution_components.role: Supplies the reasoning and generation used for Q&A, guidance and emotional interaction.

data_flow: User prompts inside the vehicle enter the NOMI interface, are sent to the cloud large-model stack for inference and reasoning, and then return as encyclopedic answers, trip guidance, ambient settings or vehicle-help responses inside the cabin UI.
business_outcome: NIO launched a more capable in-car AI partner that broadened cockpit scenarios, deepened emotional interaction and showed how large models can differentiate the smart-cabin experience.
metrics: The first release was pushed to nearly 200,000 vehicles.
The system can choose among more than 16.7 million ambient-light combinations.
architecture_clues: The feature launched across NIO's NT2.0 and 2.2 vehicle platforms
The assistant combines open-domain Q&A with vehicle-specific knowledge and cabin control
